Familiarity not check waiver; short duration versus requirements; delay prompts schedule adjustment rather than omitted inspection.
Group consent not safety evidence; management staffing/schedule conditions as well as individual behavior; endurance not sole safety plan.
Hearing instruction versus understanding target/scope; repeated sound/yes answer versus shared meaning.
Supervisor notification versus actual worker/shift handover; undated memo not current confirmed instruction.
Reflex movement example not recommendation; upper work/lower passage and tool control considered without assuming continuous grip.
